# PR #4419: Patch: Shadowstep answers only your Units that die, not your destroyed Field Spells and Traps

Closes #4395

Shadowstep's base face now answers only a Unit of yours that dies. A Field Spell, Trap or Field Trap of yours destroyed alone leaves it set. One destroyed in the same pass as your Units stays in the graveyard, and only the Units return at cost 0. A Unit standing in the backrow still counts. The Radiant face is untouched.

## What changed

- **`crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c014_shadowstep.rs`**: new `is_unit` reads the event's card by `card_type_of_face(def_id, radiant)`, as Eschews does. A `units_only` flag applies it to both `with_when` and the pass collection.
- **Kept scripts**: `script_v0_4_12b()` is now `scripts(false, false)`. The new `script_v0_6_9e()` is `scripts(true, false)`. `script()` is `scripts(true, true)`.
- **`crates/cards/src/history.rs`**: new `KEPT_SCRIPTS` row `(c014_shadowstep::ID, "v0.6.9e", script_v0_6_9e)`, `#4395 (R4395000)` added to the "Kept by" list, and one history test. The v0.4.12b row is untouched.
- **Spec**:
  - New `spec/rulings/R4395000.md`.
  - New `spec/pending/4395.md`.
  - The §8.6 row 14 Engine cell now names the ruling.
  - `spec/11-rulings.md`, `INDEX.md` and `CARDS.md` are untouched.
- **Fragment**: `crates/cards/patches/pending/shadowstep-answers-only-your-units-that-die.json`, with the player note under `fixes`.

## Tests

The `r4395000_` tests are in `c014_shadowstep.rs`; the history test is in `history.rs`.

- **Field Spell alone**: Datacenter Fire destroys it, Shadowstep stays set and the card is in the graveyard.
- **Trap alone**: Crushing Walls destroys it, Shadowstep stays set and the Unit in lane 3 is untouched.
- **Same pass**: Crushing Walls destroys a Unit and a Field Spell together. The Unit returns at cost 0, the Field Spell stays in the graveyard, and the hand is `[STOCKPILE, VANILLA]`.
- **Backrow Unit**: a Unit standing in the backrow beside a destroyed Field Spell still comes back at cost 0.
- **Kept scripts**: the `v0.4.12b` and `v0.6.9e` scripts still spring on a destroyed Field Spell and hand it back at cost 0.
- **History**: `r767000_issue_4395_shadowstep_is_kept_through_v0_6_9e_the_newest_version_that_ran_it`.

# #4395: Patch: Shadowstep answers only your Units that die, not your destroyed Field Spells and Traps
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Shadowstep is a face-down Trap that reads “When any of your Units die: return them to your hand; they cost (0)”. Today it also goes off when one of your Field Spells or Traps is destroyed, even though no Unit of yours died.

For example: you have Shadowstep set and a Mana Well in play, and your opponent casts Datacenter Fire (“Destroy all Field Spells”). No Unit of yours died, but Shadowstep springs anyway. It hands your Mana Well back at cost 0 and is used up before any Unit of yours dies. When Units and backrow cards die together (Crushing Walls), every Field Spell and Trap of yours that was destroyed also comes back free, along with the Units.

Once built, Shadowstep waits for a Unit of yours to die, as printed, and brings back only Units. A player who sets it notices; so does the opponent who clears their backrow.

## Why

- SPEC §8.6 row 14 (`spec/08-catalog.md:180`), Base: “When any of your Units die: return them to your hand; they cost (0)”. Its Engine cell: “one firing covers every Unit you controlled as it died ([[R172]]) that one state-check pass collects ([[§4.5]])”. The script's own header says the same (`crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c014_shadowstep.rs:7`: “a `destroyed` of a Unit of yours”).
- The base trigger checks only who controlled the card:
  - Its `with_when` (`c014_shadowstep.rs:71`) matches any `GameEvent::Destroyed` whose `controller` is the Trap's controller.
  - Its collection (`c014_shadowstep.rs:53-62`) keeps every `Destroyed` of the pass that is yours and in a graveyard.
  - Neither one checks that the card is a Unit.
- Non-Units do reach it:
  - §4.5 step 1 also collects backrow cards marked destroyed (`crates/engine/src/state_check.rs:1146-1159`).
  - `collect` pushes a `GameEvent::Destroyed` for each of them, with its controller (`state_check.rs:886-893`).
  - Crushing Walls' test `r59_all_eight_cards_are_destroyed_at_once_in_one_pass` (`crates/cards/src/scripts/classic_plus/c024_crushing_walls.rs:185-195`) counts 8 `Destroyed` events for two lanes' units and backrow cards on both sides.
- Another card already filters these events: Meditative #60 Eschews checks `card_type_of_face(..) != CardType::Unit` before it counts one (`crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c060_eschews.rs:72`).
- The Radiant face is already right: its “would die” replacement collects only cards in unit zones (`crates/engine/src/replacements.rs:633-636`).
- No test covers this. The base-face tests (`c014_shadowstep.rs:228-400`) cover enemy deaths, tokens, Reborn, Indestructible, stolen Units and a full hand, but never a destroyed non-Unit of yours. No ruling citing the card ([[R172]], [[R444]], [[R462]], [[R2618000]], [[R4111000]], [[R4221000]]) says it answers a Field Spell or a Trap.

## Proposal

- In the base trigger, keep only Units, both in the `with_when` and in the pass collection. Check each event's card on the face it died on, `card_type_of_face(ctx.state, def_id, radiant == Some(true)) == CardType::Unit`, as Eschews does. A Unit standing in the backrow ([[R1081000]]) is a Unit and still counts.
- Add a ruling in the issue's block, following Hearthstone's reading (a trigger on a minion dying never answers a destroyed non-minion):
  - The base face answers, and returns, only Units.
  - A Field Spell, Trap or Field Trap of yours destroyed alone leaves it set.
  - One destroyed in the same pass as your Units stays in the graveyard.
  - A Unit card set face-down as a Trap is read by its definition's type, as Eschews already reads it.
- Put the ruling's §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, and have the §8.6 row's Engine cell name it.
- Keep today's script so older replays still fold ([[R767000]]): add `classic-014` at the newest shipped version to `KEPT_SCRIPTS` in `crates/cards/src/history.rs`, beside its existing `script_v0_4_12b`.
- Add a pending fragment with `--plays classic-014`, its player note under `fixes` (`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §3).

## Where it lands

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c014_shadowstep.rs`: the base trigger and its tests.
- `crates/cards/src/history.rs`: `KEPT_SCRIPTS`.
- `crates/cards/patches/pending/<slug>.json`.
- `spec/rulings/R<issue×1000>.md`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, and `spec/08-catalog.md` §8.6 row 14's Engine cell.
- SPEC §4.5, §8.6, [[R172]].

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With a base Shadowstep set and no Unit of yours dying, destroying a Field Spell of yours (Datacenter Fire, or a plain destroy) leaves Shadowstep set face-down and the Field Spell in your graveyard.
- [ ] Destroying a Trap of yours alone leaves Shadowstep set.
- [ ] In one pass where a Unit of yours and a Field Spell of yours die together (Crushing Walls), Shadowstep returns the Unit at cost 0 and leaves the Field Spell in the graveyard.
- [ ] A Unit of yours standing in the backrow still comes back when it dies.
- [ ] Every new test is named after the new ruling and fails on today's script.
- [ ] A replay recorded before the fix still folds to its recorded hash, through the kept script.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c014_shadowstep`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` pass.

## Size and risks

Small: about ten lines of script, four or five tests, one ruling, one kept script and a fragment.

Risk: the card gets weaker for decks that were getting free Field Spells back. The text never promised that, and the kept script keeps old replays folding. The Radiant face is untouched.
